newsitem.title: USA: Lattice to provide funding for fab plant.
newsitem.headline: Lattice to provide funding for fab plant.

text.p: Lattice Semiconductor Corp Monday said it signed an agreement to advance Seiko Epson Corp up to $150 million to assist in the funding of a new eight-inch semiconductor wafer fab, currently under construction in Sakata, Japan.

The agreement calls for Lattice to make a $90 million advance payment to Seiko Epson, to facilitize the new fab, over the next two years with an option for an additional $60 million advance. In return, Lattice will receive guaranteed eight-inch, sub-micron wafer capacity.
The advance payments will be repaid by Seiko Epson with semiconductor wafers over a multi-year period.
